# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(ggthemes)
```

# Compiling datasets 

```{r}
loadData <- function(path, group, model) {
  df <- read.csv(path)
  df$group <- group # Keeping track of experimental condition 
  df$model <- model # Keeping track of model zero-shot or fine-tuned 
  df
}

control_low  <- loadData("control_low/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "control", "zero_shot") 
control_medium    <- loadData("control_medium/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "control", "zero_shot")
control_random   <- loadData("control_random/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "random", "zero_shot")
control_deceptive   <- loadData("control_deceptive/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "deceptive", "zero_shot")

avoid_low         <- loadData("avoid_low/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "avoid", "zero_shot")
avoid_medium      <- loadData("avoid_medium/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "avoid", "zero_shot")

ft_control_low    <- loadData("ft_control_low/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "control", "fine_tuned")
ft_control_medium <- loadData("ft_control_medium/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "control", "fine_tuned")
ft_avoid_low      <- loadData("ft_avoid_low/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "avoid", "fine_tuned")
ft_avoid_medium   <- loadData("ft_avoid_medium/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "avoid", "fine_tuned")


full_data <- rbind(
  control_low, control_medium, control_random, control_deceptive,
  avoid_low, avoid_medium,
  ft_control_low, ft_control_medium, ft_avoid_low, ft_avoid_medium
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    coin_and_goal = as.integer(reached_goal + coin_collected == 2),
    goal_only = as.integer(ifelse(reached_goal == 1 & coin_collected == 0, 1, 0)),
    coin_only = as.integer(ifelse(reached_goal == 0 & coin_collected == 1, 1, 0)),
    grid_size = as.factor(grid_size),
    density = as.factor(density)
  )

rm(control_low, control_medium, control_random, control_deceptive, 
   avoid_low, avoid_medium,
   ft_control_low, ft_control_medium, ft_avoid_low, ft_avoid_medium)

head(full_data)
```

# Comparing between models and conditions 

```{r}
plot_task_success <- function(df,
                               group_vars,          # e.g. c("density", "grid_size")
                               subgroup_var,        # e.g. "grid_key" -- extra grouping for the jitter layer
                               outcomes,            # named vector: c(goal = "reached_goal", coin = "coin_collected", both = "coin_and_goal")
                               facet_formula,        # e.g. grid_size ~ density
                               jitter_alpha = 0.05) {

  group_syms <- syms(group_vars)
  subgroup_syms <- syms(c(group_vars, subgroup_var))

  # Build summarise() expressions programmatically from the outcomes vector
  summarise_exprs <- unlist(lapply(names(outcomes), function(nm) {
    col <- sym(outcomes[[nm]])
    setNames(
      list(
        expr(mean(!!col)),
        expr(sd(!!col) / sqrt(n()))
      ),
      c(paste0("mean_", nm), paste0("se_", nm))
    )
  }), recursive = FALSE)

  summary_overall <- df %>%
    group_by(!!!group_syms) %>%
    summarise(!!!summarise_exprs, .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -all_of(group_vars),
      names_to = c(".value", "metric"),
      names_pattern = "(mean|se)_(.*)"
    )

  summary_by_subgroup <- df %>%
    group_by(!!!subgroup_syms) %>%
    summarise(!!!summarise_exprs, .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -all_of(c(group_vars, subgroup_var)),
      names_to = c(".value", "metric"),
      names_pattern = "(mean|se)_(.*)"
    )

  ggplot() +
    geom_col(data = summary_overall, aes(x = metric, y = mean, fill = metric)) +
    geom_errorbar(data = summary_overall,
                  aes(x = metric, fill = metric, y = mean,
                      ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
                  width = 0.3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
    geom_jitter(data = summary_by_subgroup,
                aes(x = metric, y = mean, fill = metric),
                position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.5, dodge.width = 0.9),
                alpha = jitter_alpha) +
    facet_grid(facet_formula, labeller = label_both) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Task success", fill = NULL) +
    theme_light() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "none")
}
```

# Control, low, medium reasoning

```{r}
low_comparison_plot <- full_data %>%
  filter(group == "control", model == "zero_shot", reasoning_effort == "low") %>%
  plot_task_success(

    subgroup_var = "grid_key",
    outcomes = c("Goal only" = "goal_only", "Coin only" = "coin_only", "Both" = "coin_and_goal"),
    facet_formula = grid_size ~ density
```


```{r}
control_random_comparison <- full_data %>%
  filter(reasoning_effort %in% c("medium","low", "random"), model == "zero_shot", group != "avoid") %>%
  group_by(density, grid_size, reasoning_effort) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_both = mean(coin_and_goal),
    se_both = sd(coin_and_goal)/sqrt(n()),
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(density, grid_size, reasoning_effort),
    names_to = c(".value", "metric"),
    names_pattern = "(mean|se)_(.*)"
  )

control_random_comparison_by_grid <- full_data %>%
  filter(reasoning_effort %in% c("medium","low", "random"), model == "zero_shot", group != "avoid") %>%
  group_by(density, grid_size, grid_key, reasoning_effort) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_both = mean(coin_and_goal),
    se_both = sd(coin_and_goal)/sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(density, grid_size, reasoning_effort, grid_key),
    names_to = c(".value", "metric"),
    names_pattern = "(mean|se)_(.*)"
  )

reasoning_random_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = control_random_comparison, aes(x = reasoning_effort, y = mean, fill = reasoning_effort)) + 
  geom_errorbar(data = control_random_comparison, aes(x = reasoning_effort, 
                                          fill = reasoning_effort, 
                                          y = mean, 
                                          ymin = mean - se, 
                                          ymax = mean + se), 
                width = 0.3,position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  
   geom_jitter(data = control_random_comparison_by_grid, aes(x = reasoning_effort, y = mean, fill = reasoning_effort), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.5, dodge.width = 0.9), alpha = 0.05) +
  
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  
  facet_grid(grid_size ~ density, labeller = label_both) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Task success", fill = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
reasoning_random_plot
```

# Statistical tests

```{r}
df1 <- full_data %>%
  filter(reasoning_effort == "low", 
         group == "control", 
         model == "zero_shot", 
         !trajectory_category %in% c("reshuffled_walls", "random_starts")) %>%
  mutate(
    trajectory_category = fct_relevel(trajectory_category, "base"),
    grid_size = factor(grid_size,
                       levels = c("7", "9", "11"),
                       ordered = TRUE),
    density = factor(density,
                     levels = c("0","0.2","0.4","0.6"),
                     ordered = TRUE)
  )

summary(glm(coin_and_goal ~ 1 + trajectory_category + grid_size + density + coin_detour_distance, data = df1))
```

```{r}
glmer1 <- glmer(coin_and_goal ~ 1 + trajectory_category + grid_size * density + coin_detour_distance + (1 + grid_size + density | grid_key), 
                   family = binomial(), 
                   control=glmerControl(optimizer='bobyqa'), 
                   data = df1)

summary(glmer1)
```

# Uncertainty and accuracy metrics 

```{r}
success_control <- full_data %>% 
  filter(!trajectory_category %in% c("random_starts","reshuffled_walls"),
         group == "control", model == "zero_shot", reasoning_effort == "low") %>%
  group_by(grid_key) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_accuracy = mean(coin_and_goal)
  )

control_low_by_grid <- read.csv("control_low/coin_trajectory_metrics_low.csv") %>%
  filter(!trajectory_category %in% c("random_starts","reshuffled_walls")) 

# Checking to see if both match 
check_df <- control_low_by_grid %>%
  select(grid_id, full_success_rate) %>%
  inner_join(success_control, by = c("grid_id" = "grid_key"))

all(check_df$mean_accuracy == check_df$full_success_rate)
```

```{r}
control_low_by_grid %>%
  group_by(grid_size, density) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c(mean_entropy, mean_jsd, ece),      # or any set of columns
      list(mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
           se   = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(.x)))),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# --- 1. Rename columns to a consistent measure_phase pattern -----------------
metrics_renamed <- control_low_by_grid %>%
  rename(
    accuracy_overall        = mean_action_accuracy,
    accuracy_phase1         = mean_action_accuracy_phase1,
    accuracy_phase2         = mean_action_accuracy_phase2,
    entropy_overall         = mean_entropy,
    entropy_phase1          = mean_entropy_phase1,
    entropy_phase2          = mean_entropy_phase2,
    jsd_overall             = mean_jsd,
    jsd_phase1              = mean_jsd_phase1,
    jsd_phase2              = mean_jsd_phase2,
    # optimalentropy_overall  = mean_optimal_entropy,
    # optimalentropy_phase1   = mean_optimal_entropy_phase1,
    # optimalentropy_phase2   = mean_optimal_entropy_phase2
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    grid_size = factor(grid_size),
    density   = factor(density)
  )

# --- 2. Reshape to long format, keeping every raw row (for jitter) ----------
metrics_long_raw <- metrics_renamed %>%
  select(grid_size, density,
         accuracy_overall,       accuracy_phase1,       accuracy_phase2,
         entropy_overall,        entropy_phase1,        entropy_phase2,
         jsd_overall,            jsd_phase1,            jsd_phase2) %>%
         # optimalentropy_overall, optimalentropy_phase1, optimalentropy_phase2
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(grid_size, density),
    names_to = c("measure", "phase"),
    names_pattern = "(accuracy|entropy|jsd|optimalentropy)_(overall|phase1|phase2)",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    measure = factor(measure,
                      levels = c("accuracy", "entropy", "jsd", "optimalentropy"),
                      labels = c("Accuracy", "Entropy", "JSD", "Optimal Entropy")),
    phase   = factor(phase, levels = c("overall", "phase1", "phase2"),
                      labels = c("Overall", "Coin", "Terminal"))
  )

# --- 3. Mean and SE per grid_size x density x measure x phase ---------------
metrics_long_stats <- metrics_long_raw %>%
  group_by(grid_size, density, measure, phase) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_val   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(value))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 4. Plot: bars + SE error bars + jittered raw points --------------------
ggplot(metrics_long_stats, aes(x = measure, y = mean_val, fill = density)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8,
           colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = metrics_long_raw,
    aes(x = measure, y = value, fill = density),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8),
    size = 0.8, alpha = 0.1, shape = 16, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_grid(phase ~ grid_size, labeller = label_both) +
  labs(
    title = "Accuracy, Entropy, JSD, and Optimal Entropy by Phase, Grid Size, and Density",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Value",
    fill = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    # panel.grid = element_blank(),
    # strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey85", colour = "black"),
    # strip.text = element_text(color = "black", face = "plain"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

# Movement metrics

```{r}
# --- 1. Reshape to long format, keeping every raw row (for jitter) ----------
quadrant_long_raw <- full_data %>% 
  filter(!trajectory_category %in% c("random_starts","reshuffled_walls"),
         group == "control", model == "zero_shot", reasoning_effort == "low") %>%
  mutate(
    grid_size = factor(grid_size),
    density   = factor(density)
  ) %>%
  select(grid_size, density, grid_key,
         quadrant_fraction_ul, quadrant_fraction_ur,
         quadrant_fraction_dl, quadrant_fraction_dr) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(grid_size, density, grid_key),
    names_to = "quadrant",
    names_prefix = "quadrant_fraction_",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    quadrant = factor(quadrant,
                       levels = c("ul", "ur", "dl", "dr"),
                       labels = c("Upper Left", "Upper Right", "Lower Left", "Lower Right"))
  )

# --- 2. Mean and SE per grid_size x density x quadrant ----------------------
quadrant_long_stats <- quadrant_long_raw %>%
  group_by(grid_size, density, quadrant) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_val   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(value))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

quadrant_long_grids <- quadrant_long_raw %>%
  group_by(grid_size, density, grid_key, quadrant) %>%
  summarise(
    value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_val   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(value))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 3. Plot: bars + SE error bars + jittered raw points --------------------
ggplot(quadrant_long_stats, aes(x = quadrant, y = mean_val, fill = density)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8,
           colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = quadrant_long_grids,
    aes(x = quadrant, y = value, fill = density),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8),
    size = 0.8, alpha = 0.1, shape = 16, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_grid(~ grid_size, labeller = label_both) +
  labs(
    title = "Quadrant Fraction by Grid Size and Density",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Fraction",
    fill = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```
